title: GTA6 Officially Rated in Australia? Community Compares Ratings
description: GTA6 has reportedly received its official age rating in Australia. Reddit community discusses the content comparisons between GTA6 and GTA5.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Officially Rated in Australia? Community Compares Content Scale

As the anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reach fever pitch, players are scrutinizing every piece of information that surfaces online. Recently, a post shared on the r/GTA6 Reddit community by user /u/Playful-Ad-6475 has brought attention to what is claimed to be the official age rating and content classification for *GTA6* in Australia. Please note that this information originates from social media and community discussions, and should be viewed with a degree of caution as an unconfirmed report.

### Breaking Down the Classification Comparison

According to information originally posted by Gameroll on Twitter, the rating details assign specific rankings and accompanying keys to various categories. This setup allows observers to draw direct comparisons between the content of *GTA6* and its predecessor, *GTA5*.

As the Reddit user pointed out, "The left image is what GTA6 received and on the right is GTAV's. This helps us put into perspective how far Rockstar is truly pushing things with this game. Pretty nuts considering that GTA5 was considered VERY controversial at the time." Furthermore, the comparison allegedly includes classification data for *Red Dead Redemption 2* (RDR2) further to the right, offering a broader look at how Rockstar's titles are assessed under Australian guidelines.

### Pushing the Boundaries of Open-World Content

Australia's classification board has historically been known for its stringent stance on mature themes, violence, and interactive media. If the circulating rating details offer any genuine insight into how *GTA6* is being evaluated, it suggests that Rockstar Games is once again pushing the envelope in terms of mature content and thematic depth. Given how controversial *GTA5* was deemed upon its initial release, the prospect of an even more intense experience has certainly caught the attention of the gaming community.

While we await official word and final confirmation from regulatory bodies or Rockstar Games itself, these community-driven discussions highlight the immense curiosity surrounding the game's final content. 

## Editor's Take

While this Australian classification leak remains unconfirmed community news, it offers a fascinating glimpse into how *GTA6* might stack up against past Rockstar titles. If the comparisons hold any truth, players should expect a deeply provocative experience that redefines industry standards for mature gaming content.
